# FinKit

> FinKit is a Traditional Chinese personal-finance calculator and education site for Taiwan users. Canonical domain: https://finkit.top/

## Core purpose
FinKit helps users estimate and understand cash flow, emergency funds, debt, investing, mortgages, retirement, Taiwan tax topics, foreign exchange, and structured-product scenarios. Results are educational estimates and are not tax, legal, insurance, or investment advice.

- Overseas income / Taiwan AMT calculator (115 / 2026 rules): https://finkit.top/tools/taiwan-overseas-income-tax-calculator.html

## Overseas income facts used by FinKit
- For Taiwan resident individuals, household overseas income reaching TWD 1,000,000 is generally included in individual basic income in full; below TWD 1,000,000 it is generally not included.
- The individual basic-income deduction is TWD 7,500,000 for 2026 (ROC year 115); this is not a standalone overseas-income exemption.
- Basic tax is generally calculated as (basic income - TWD 7,500,000) × 20% when basic income exceeds the deduction.
- 2026 Taiwan individual income-tax brackets are 5%, 12%, 20%, 30%, and 40%, with net-income thresholds of TWD 610,000 / 1,380,000 / 2,770,000 / 5,190,000.
- 2026 personal exemption is TWD 101,000; standard deduction is TWD 136,000 for single filers and TWD 272,000 for married joint filers; salary special deduction is up to TWD 227,000 per eligible person.

## Source policy
For Taiwan tax rules, FinKit prioritizes the Ministry of Finance, eTax Portal, and National Taxation Bureau sources. Tax pages should state the applicable tax year and last-updated date. Market and product calculations are estimates and should be checked against official product documents or current market data.
